cr_data.provenance: (An American Place, New York, NY); Anita O'Keeffe (Mrs. Robert R.) Young, Newport, Rhode Island, 1943; Estate of Anita O'Keeffe (Mrs. Robert R.) Young, 1985; Robert R. Young Foundation, Cinncinati, Ohio, 1985; Sotheby's, New York, NY, sale no. 5658, lot no. 4, 3 December 1987 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Miss O'Keeffe says the picture was sold to Anita O'Keeffe (Mrs. Robert R.) Young after the Chicago exhibition." Reproduced and titled *Autumn Leaves* in *Arts and Decoration* (March 1933); reproduced and titled *Autumn – Leaves* in *America & Alfred Stieglitz* (1934). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
